observer: fixed exact G4 tensor, min eigenaxis
normalization: H only, NEVER normalize derivative coefficients
family: nonseparable odd/even symmetric5x5 six unconstrained-gain coefficients
loss: prototype variance log mean(I/P), within-unit CV squared, clean angle squared, paired noise log-I change
proxy: all17train prototypes; two crossed rotation/shift poses; paired noise0,.002,.005,.01 (clean-only excludes noisy inputs)

optimizer.gradient: PyTorch reverse autograd, bounded-memory exact two-pass chain rule; independently checked against exact forward Jacobian

separable: same maxiter/maxfun, fixed moment1, starts G4, clean and noise1
selection: N10: exclude fitted candidates worse than G4 in clean log-q variance; per-noise-weight select minimum declared objective on validation with G4 always anchored; separately select N among5/10/20/30 for the frozen noise1 arm via same validation objective
test: freeze protocol,manifest,models,reference set,N,weights before single fresh test; no test-based ruler selection

resources.threeD: verified12orbit kernels and differentiation smoke only; no allotted3D optimization budget; 8GiB CPU environment, prioritize full2D multistart
resources.wider: 7x7,exchange,observer retuning deferred; no automatic budget expansion
